tasks.label: Visual question answering
tasks.mapping_rationale: MMBench/MM-Vet provide general visual QA evidence; HallusionBench is specifically hallucination-related. Settings must match.

tasks.label: OCR and text extraction
tasks.definition: Read or extract text visible in an image.
tasks.mapping_rationale: OCRBench measures a mixture of recognition and reasoning; it is task evidence, not a direct measure of every OCR workflow.

tasks.label: Document understanding
tasks.definition: Read and answer questions about document pages and layouts.
tasks.mapping_rationale: DocVQA is evidence for document QA, not all document processing.

tasks.label: Chart and table understanding
tasks.definition: Extract or reason about information in charts or visual tables.
tasks.mapping_rationale: ChartQA supports chart understanding; it does not measure every table workflow.

tasks.label: Visual and mathematical reasoning
tasks.definition: Reason over visual evidence, spatial relations, diagrams, or math.
tasks.mapping_rationale: Benchmarks differ in domain and protocol; never pool raw scores. Chinese 推理 is a candidate: capability/math/logic/visual contexts assign reasoning; speed/memory/deployment/error-only contexts are runtime. Ambiguous usage stays a candidate.

tasks.label: Image description
tasks.mapping_rationale: No direct caption benchmark is in the current score table; leave quantitative task evidence missing.

tasks.label: Multimodal conversation
tasks.definition: Follow instructions or maintain dialogue grounded in images.
tasks.mapping_rationale: No single general benchmark is treated as a direct measure of conversation quality. A chat template is a setup detail, not task evidence.

tasks.label: Video understanding
tasks.definition: Answer questions about video frames and temporal events; adjacent to the image-and-text scope.
tasks.mapping_rationale: Video-only feedback is excluded; image/video combined feedback can retain this secondary tag.
